nodes.label: Persistable<UUID> isNew flag pattern for domain-assigned IDs
nodes.rationale: User.create() assigned UUID.randomUUID() so Spring Data JPA saw id != null and called merge() instead of persist(), causing ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException. Fixed by implementing Persistable<UUID> with a @Transient isNew flag set to true in create() and reset to false in @PostLoad, allowing persist() to be called reliably.

nodes.label: Spring Security /error path must be in permitAll()
nodes.rationale: When an unhandled exception occurs, Spring forwards internally to /error. If /error is not in permitAll(), AuthorizationFilter blocks it with 403, masking the real error from the client.
